# Lumina Voice
Website: https://lumina-voice.com
Description: Archive.org-only Urdu audio library (ghazals, audiobooks and poetry). Ads are separate; radio paused.

## Categories
- Archive.org public-domain audio, Poetry, Ghazals, Audiobooks, Drama, Quran Kareem, Advertising IDs & Jingles

## Key Features
- Quran Kareem with Urdu Translation
- Audiobook support
- Natural on-device Urdu speech: Android TTS voice pack, Urdu digits/punctuation and human-like pauses
- Device Admin → Archive library: read-only review of 100 Internet Archive candidates across six genre shelves. Publishing is gated on item page, MP3, probed duration, Urdu language and explicit reuse rights; 0 records published so far.
- Device Admin → File library: every file row has an actions menu (play, edit, replace audio, share, open, delete). House titles are edited through local overrides; imported parts can be deleted permanently.
- Archive-only catalogue: every visible title must carry a direct `https://archive.org/download/...` audio URL. `src/data/contentPolicy.js` gates bundled, imported, cloud, playability and transfer data; demo, house, local and custom story audio are removed from web, tablet and Supabase. `www.archive.org` links are canonicalised to `archive.org` for CORS-safe playback.
- Shipped catalogue: one public-domain title, `selected-ghazals-of-ghalib` (35 LibriVox MP3 episodes). Advertising stays in `src/data/ads.js` and native `ad-*` audio is untouched. Now Playing keeps cover art separate with a labelled spectrum strip below it (native uses an animated pulse because the Web Audio analyser mutes device playback).
- Subtitles appear automatically from the first saved track (Urdu → English → Arabic preference), with Auto and Off controls. Live speech-to-text of streaming audio is not supported by the Android WebView used here.
- Archive.org metadata resolution is cached per item and warmed on the title page, so tapping play starts sound in under a second instead of waiting for a metadata round trip.
- The app is connected to the Supabase `luminavoice` project via Connect → Framework → React → Vite (public URL + publishable key, no SDK needed). With no signal, sign-in falls back to the local demo account and the bundled catalog still works.
- Signed-in listeners sync library saves, playback positions and history between the Android tablet and the local web app through the Supabase `user_state` table; audio files and downloads remain on each device. Realtime events refresh ratings, reviews, the catalogue and profiles live.
- Archive.org links stream directly in the app; no audio is copied into app storage. Direct URLs are never rewritten with a `.opus`/`.m4a` suffix. `www.archive.org` links are canonicalized to `archive.org` and requested with CORS so the Web Audio spectrum analyser receives real samples; other external streams use plain audio plus a decorative pulse.
- Settings → Transfer data (`/transfer`): metadata-only JSON backup/restore of Archive.org title links, edits, history and playback settings on web and Android. Audio bytes and non-Archive entries in old backups are ignored; the native APK ships only advertisement audio (~6 MB).
- Any email account can sign in, but exactly one account is admin: `info@alasarjadeed.com`. That rule is shared by GitHub docs, local web, the tablet and Supabase policies; stale profile roles or addresses containing "admin" never grant privileges. Admin also has Lumina Plus.
- The tablet is not a data silo. It uses the same Supabase REST + Realtime project as the website for library, progress and history, with `/transfer` JSON export/import as the offline cross-platform bridge.
- Admin → Cloud catalogue manages Archive.org links in Supabase with a published/draft switch. A 15-minute cron publishes published archive-only stories as metadata-only `/catalogue.json`; web and tablet pull it on login/resume/timer and fall back to the last cached snapshot. Local website links and private-use admin features remain intact.

## Launch
- Static PWA served by nginx on localhost (private LAN access is configured locally)
- No VS Code needed: `docker-compose up -d --build`; desktop icon `Lumina Voice.desktop` runs `scripts/open-lumina.sh` to start the container if stopped and open the app
- Zero-cost: no streaming server, database, API key or paid provider required
- Observability: pino logs; Sentry alerts disabled without a DSN

## Contact
studio@lumina-voice.com

## Radio feature — PAUSED (2026-11-17)
- Public live radio is disabled until broadcast resources are available. Radio source is kept intact for a one-switch relaunch.
- Feature flag: `VITE_RADIO_ENABLED` (default `false`, set in `.env.production` / `.env.example`). `src/config/features.js` exports `RADIO_ENABLED`.
- When `false`: no Radio nav tab or `/radio` route (old `/radio` redirects to `/`), no embed page, no Home/Site radio links, no Broadcast Studio (`/admin` opens the radio-free Device Admin for admins), no radio voice commands or alerts, no external-stream stats/embeds, and no broadcast-server requests. `loadStreamConfig()` reports `enabled: false`; `useNowPlaying`, `playExternal`, `playRadio`, `playBroadcast`, AzuraCast API and show reminders are no-ops.
- All radio code (Broadcast Studio, bundled Sada Bahar desk, AzuraCast config, embeds) stays in the source tree, fully gated — nothing radio-related runs while the flag is off.
- Relaunch: set `VITE_RADIO_ENABLED=true`, rebuild (`npm run build` / `docker compose up -d --build`) and radio pages, tabs, embeds and stream calls return unchanged.
- Verified after archive-only cleanup and cloud-catalogue delivery: `npm run lint`, `npm test` (155/155), `npm run build`, Docker rebuild. Non-Archive cloud story removed via REST; radio remains paused. Applying `docs/supabase-admin-lockdown.sql` and `docs/supabase-archive-only.sql` (DDL) is the remaining cloud step.

## Huawei AppGallery release
- Public privacy policy: `https://www.alasarjadeed.com/privacy`; Settings → Privacy and Account → Delete account link to it or prepare a deletion request.
- Store build: `npm run build:store` generates `.env.store` with bundled `/catalogue.json`, radio off and broadcast keys blanked; release manifest disables cleartext traffic.
- Signed AAB: JDK 21 `./gradlew clean bundleRelease`; keystore outside repo; `versionCode 2`, `versionName 1.0.0`.
- Submission pack: `docs/store/huawei-appgallery.md` (English/Urdu copy, screenshots, rights, rating answers).
